title: World
html_source: Mistake No. 1 in her letter. The Joycean running joke here is that Martha, his respondent to an ad for a typist, has poor grammar and spelling, with several mistakes in even such a short letter, and so probably isn’t much of a typist. Bloom jokes to himself about this a couple of paragraphs later “Wonder did she wrote it herself.”
